description: In Midtown Manhattan, timeless elegance and ample natural light fill this versatile space that sits in the center of the city's magic. Here, you'll find the inspiration for both work and life in abundance.

At the intersection of Lafayette Street, 148 Lafayette rises twelve stories at the corner of one of New York’s most dynamic neighborhoods. Its architecture is informed by the area’s historic buildings, while expansive ceiling heights bring in abundant natural light. The building is rooted in the creative vitality of its iconic surroundings.

This boutique office space is a classic piece of architectural history that boasts stunning façade renovations and oversized windows, filling each space with natural light. Located in vibrant Hudson Square, forward thinking and creative companies will flourish here.

Discover the perfect union of office space and location at this sleek and modern building, located just a 5-block walk from Grand Central Station. Here you'll find leasing options that fit your business needs, and amenities and hospitality that will help you make every day excellent.

520 Madison Avenue stands at the center of Midtown, where its location creates a refined setting for leading businesses. The building features refined workspaces alongside a curated collection of on-site retail. Surrounded by cultural institutions and New York landmarks, it places companies within one of the city’s most connected corridors and supports growth on a global scale.

With direct access to Grand Central Station and a beautifully refreshed lobby, 6 Grand Central offers maximum convenience and a warm welcome. The renovated lobby, modernized pre-builds and full-floor opportunities allow businesses the flexibility they need to thrive.
Located on the edge of Central Park, CitySpire's fresh renovations, including a stunning lobby and an on-site Studio, are all designed to enhance your Manhattan lifestyle and work-life experience.

Morgan North is where life, work and nature harmonize. With its expansive skylights, green spaces, and a two-acre private rooftop park, every detail is designed to elevate the daily experience and transform your workday.

Rockefeller Center is the best of New York, reinvented daily. Around every corner is an opportunity to discover the unexpected, make meaningful connections, and experience the best views, food, and community in the city. It is where community and creativity collide.

Thought leadership thrives in this indoor-outdoor design concept. Smoothly integrating industrial-era charm with modernity, this space offers a landscaped terrace, modern amenities, spectacular views and breathtaking design, creating a one-of-a-kind workplace destination.

Soaring over 1,000 feet and 66 stories into the Manhattan air, The Spiral is a beacon of human achievement and a bold statement of vision and optimism. Its most unique features are the winding terraces that work their way up the side of the building and are the inspiration for The Spiral's name. It is a building that puts people at the forefront of its mission and design.

Combining new and renovated historic art deco, The Wheeler has preserved its connection to its past, while offering large floor plates perfect for innovative, creative companies. With easy access to 13 subway lines and surrounded by a myriad of visionary companies, restaurants, and shops, The Wheeler's location is accessible in every way.
